description: Get a complete snapshot of your financial health in seconds. WealthCheck analyzes your income, expenses, savings, and debt to calculate your net worth, savings rate, and monthly spending — then gives you a personalized action plan to improve. Whether you're budgeting for the first time or optimizing an existing plan, see exactly where your money goes and what to do next.
